title: Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) & Membrane Operating Rules

operating_parameters.chemically_enhanced_backwash_ceb: Daily with NaOCl (200 ppm) & Citric Acid (1000 ppm)

mandatory_rules: Pre-filtration through 100-micron auto-backwash screen filter is mandatory before UF.
UF Permeate SDI15 must be logged every 4 hours; if SDI15 > 3.0, trigger CEB cycle.
Air scouring at 1.2 bar must run during every backwash cycle to loosen surface cake layer.

subsystems.membrane_type: Thin Film Composite (TFC) Polyamide Spiral Wound
mandatory_rules: ORP sensor interlock: Automatically shut down RO high pressure pump if feed ORP > 250 mV to prevent chlorine oxidation of membranes.
Antiscalant dosing pump interlock: High pressure pump will not start unless antiscalant flow switch confirms positive chemical flow.
Maintain minimum concentrated brine cross-flow velocity to prevent concentration polarization.

subsystems.equipment_type: Falling Film + Forced Circulation Evaporator with ATFD
mandatory_rules: Operate 1st and 2nd effects under falling film configuration for thermal efficiency, followed by forced circulation for crystallizing stage.
Clean heat exchanger tubes with sulfamic acid flush when overall heat transfer coefficient (U-value) drops by > 15%.
Recovered salt (NaCl/Na2SO4) from Agitated Thin Film Dryer (ATFD) must be tested for moisture (< 2%) before bagging.
